log: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE isolated gameplay obstacle sprite for Wobbly Duck cute 2D side-view browser game. Input duck sprite sheet is the AUTHORITATIVE STYLE reference only: smooth thick dark navy outline (#263B59), chunky rounded shapes, cheerful colours, simple two-tone cel shading and restrained warm highlights. Match the duck precisely in line weight and illustration style; no realistic texture, painterly detail, glossy 3D, tiny decoration or pixel art. Create 1024x1024 transparent PNG with genuine alpha, isolated object centered with generous transparent margin all around. Every edge fully inside frame. No environment, water, splash, shadow outside silhouette, glow, haze, character, UI, lettering or watermark. No black/checkerboard painted backdrop. Render sharp and clear at small gameplay size. Subject: ONE horizontal floating wooden log, side-on cylinder, long low rounded silhouette approximately 760 pixels wide and 230 pixels tall centered on canvas. Warm honey brown bark with slightly darker flat underside shading, very few curved simple bark marks. Right end a pale tan oval cut face with two simple rounded growth-ring curves, dark navy contour. Opposite end rounded. No branches, knots protruding, leaves, rope, spikes or extra items. Log horizontal, no rotation; no water or float effects. Overall shape ratio around 3.3:1 matching the current game's log.
